import dlt
from pyspark.sql.functions import col
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()

# Create the streaming table to maintain SCD Type 2 history
dlt.create_streaming_table("consumer_mv_history")

# Apply CDC from the landing stream
dlt.apply_changes(
    target="consumer_mv_history",
    source=dlt.read("consumer_cdc_stream"),
    keys=["consumer_id"],
    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
    except_column_list=["operation", "ingestion_time"],
    stored_as_scd_type=2
)

# Bronze materialized view: current records with columns dropped
@dlt.table(
    name="consumer_mv",
    comment="Bronze view with current consumer records",
    table_properties={"quality": "bronze"}
)
def consumer_mv():
    df = dlt.read("consumer_cdc_stream")
    # Filter to current active records
    df_filtered = df.filter("__START_AT IS NOT NULL AND __END_AT IS NULL")
    # Drop SCD metadata columns
    columns_to_drop = ["__START_AT", "__END_AT", "__OPERATION"]
    return df_filtered.drop(*columns_to_drop)
